With his buzzer-beating jumper to beat the Nets in OT, Jayson Tatum made his 7th career game-winning shot with under 3 seconds remaining. He passes Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (6) for the most game-winners under 3 seconds since the start of the 2019-20 season.
